import math

class Ratio(int numerator, int denominator)

int parse_integer(string text)
    return int(text)

int gcd_integer(int left, int right)
    left = math.abs(left)
    right = math.abs(right)
    while right != 0
        left, right = right, left % right
    return left

Ratio ratio_parts(real value)
    text := string(value)
    fields := text.split("/")
    if #fields == 2
        return Ratio(parse_integer(fields[0]), parse_integer(fields[1]))
    fields = text.split(".")
    if #fields == 1
        return Ratio(parse_integer(text), 1)
    denominator := 10 ^ int(#fields[1])
    numerator := parse_integer(fields[0]) * denominator + (if text.starts_with("-") then -1 else 1) * parse_integer(fields[1])
    divisor := gcd_integer(numerator, denominator)
    return Ratio(numerator / divisor, denominator / divisor)

string fraction_text(real value)
    parts := ratio_parts(value)
    return if parts.denominator == 1 then string(parts.numerator) else "{parts.numerator}/{parts.denominator}"

real | error rational(string text)
    fields := text.split("/")
    numerator := parse_integer(fields[0])
    denominator := if #fields == 2 then parse_integer(fields[1]) else 1
    if denominator == 0
        return error("ZERO DENOMINATOR")
    return real(numerator) / real(denominator)

bool includes<T>(const T[] values, T sought)
    for item := values[]
        if item == sought
            return true
    return false

void emit(string text)
    println(text)

class Polynomial(real[] coefficients := [])

Polynomial normalized(const real[] coefficients)
    count := int(#coefficients)
    while count > 0 and coefficients[count - 1] == 0.0
        count -= 1
    return Polynomial(coefficients[0:<count])

Polynomial constant(real value)
    return if value == 0.0 then Polynomial() else Polynomial([value])

int degree(const Polynomial polynomial)
    return int(#polynomial.coefficients) - 1

real leading(const Polynomial polynomial)
    return polynomial.coefficients[degree(polynomial)]

real coefficient(const Polynomial polynomial, int index)
    return if index <= degree(polynomial) then polynomial.coefficients[index] else 0.0

Polynomial add(const Polynomial left, const Polynomial right)
    count := math.max(degree(left), degree(right)) + 1
    return normalized([for index := (0:<int(count))[] then coefficient(left, index) + coefficient(right, index)])

Polynomial subtract(const Polynomial left, const Polynomial right)
    count := math.max(degree(left), degree(right)) + 1
    return normalized([for index := (0:<int(count))[] then coefficient(left, index) - coefficient(right, index)])

Polynomial negated(const Polynomial polynomial)
    return Polynomial(0.0 - polynomial.coefficients)

Polynomial scaled(const Polynomial polynomial, real multiplier)
    return normalized(polynomial.coefficients * multiplier)

Polynomial divided(const Polynomial polynomial, real divisor)
    return normalized(polynomial.coefficients / divisor)

Polynomial product(const Polynomial left, const Polynomial right)
    if degree(left) < 0 or degree(right) < 0
        return Polynomial()
    coefficients := array(nat(degree(left) + degree(right) + 1), fill = 0.0)
    for first := left.coefficients.indices()[]
        for second := right.coefficients.indices()[]
            coefficients[first + second] += left.coefficients[first] * right.coefficients[second]
    return normalized(coefficients)

Polynomial power(const Polynomial polynomial, int exponent)
    if exponent == 0
        return constant(1.0)
    if degree(polynomial) < 0
        return Polynomial()
    if degree(polynomial) == 0 and math.abs(leading(polynomial)) == 1.0
        return if exponent % 2 == 0 then constant(1.0) else polynomial
    result := constant(1.0)
    for: 0 <= index < exponent
        result = product(result, polynomial)
    return result

real scalar_power(real base, int exponent)
    result := 1.0
    for: 0 <= index < exponent
        result *= base
    return result

class Division(Polynomial quotient, Polynomial remainder)

Division divide_polynomials(const Polynomial dividend, const Polynomial divisor)
    quotient := array(nat(math.max(0, degree(dividend) - degree(divisor) + 1)), fill = 0.0)
    remainder := dividend
    while degree(remainder) >= 0 and degree(remainder) >= degree(divisor)
        factor := leading(remainder) / leading(divisor)
        offset := degree(remainder) - degree(divisor)
        quotient[offset] = factor
        for index := divisor.coefficients.indices()[]
            remainder.coefficients[offset + int(index)] -= factor * divisor.coefficients[index]
        remainder = normalized(remainder.coefficients)
    return Division(normalized(quotient), remainder)

Polynomial monic(const Polynomial polynomial)
    return if degree(polynomial) < 0 then polynomial else divided(polynomial, leading(polynomial))

Polynomial derivative(const Polynomial polynomial)
    return Polynomial([for index := (1:<(int(degree(polynomial)) + 1))[] then real(index) * polynomial.coefficients[index]])

Polynomial differentiated(Polynomial polynomial, int count)
    for: 0 <= index < count
        polynomial = derivative(polynomial)
    return polynomial

Polynomial integral(const Polynomial polynomial)
    coefficients := [0.0]
    for index := polynomial.coefficients.indices()[]
        coefficients = coefficients.append(polynomial.coefficients[index] / real(index + 1))
    return normalized(coefficients)

real evaluate(const Polynomial polynomial, real argument)
    result := 0.0
    for: degree(polynomial) >= index >= 0 step -1
        result = result * argument + polynomial.coefficients[index]
    return result

Polynomial compose(const Polynomial outer, const Polynomial inner)
    result := Polynomial()
    for: degree(outer) >= index >= 0 step -1
        result = add(product(result, inner), constant(outer.coefficients[index]))
    return result

Polynomial gcd_polynomials(Polynomial left, Polynomial right)
    while degree(right) >= 0
        remainder := divide_polynomials(left, right).remainder
        left = right
        right = remainder
    return monic(left)

class Bezout(Polynomial common, Polynomial left, Polynomial right)

Bezout extended_gcd(Polynomial first, Polynomial second)
    s0 := constant(1.0)
    s1 := Polynomial()
    t0 := Polynomial()
    t1 := constant(1.0)
    while degree(second) >= 0
        division := divide_polynomials(first, second)
        following_s := subtract(s0, product(division.quotient, s1))
        following_t := subtract(t0, product(division.quotient, t1))
        first = second
        second = division.remainder
        s0 = s1
        s1 = following_s
        t0 = t1
        t1 = following_t
    if degree(first) >= 0
        lead := leading(first)
        first = divided(first, lead)
        s0 = divided(s0, lead)
        t0 = divided(t0, lead)
    return Bezout(first, s0, t0)

real content(const Polynomial polynomial)
    denominator := 1
    numerator := 0
    for value := polynomial.coefficients[]
        parts := ratio_parts(value)
        denominator = denominator * parts.denominator / gcd_integer(denominator, parts.denominator)
        numerator = gcd_integer(numerator, parts.numerator)
    result := real(numerator) / real(denominator)
    return if leading(polynomial) < 0.0 then -result else result

Polynomial primitive(const Polynomial polynomial)
    return divided(polynomial, content(polynomial))

Polynomial squarefree_part(const Polynomial polynomial)
    if degree(polynomial) < 1
        return polynomial
    return divide_polynomials(polynomial, gcd_polynomials(polynomial, derivative(polynomial))).quotient

string notation(const Polynomial polynomial, variable := "x")
    result := ""
    for: degree(polynomial) >= index >= 0 step -1
        value := polynomial.coefficients[index]
        if value == 0.0
            continue
        term := ""
        if index == 0 or math.abs(value) != 1.0
            term = fraction_text(math.abs(value))
        if index > 0
            term += variable
        if index > 1
            term += "^{index}"
        if result == ""
            if value < 0.0
                result = "-"
        else
            result += if value < 0.0 then " - " else " + "
        result += term
    return if result == "" then "0" else result

class Algebra()
    polynomials := map<string, Polynomial>()

Polynomial | error lookup(const Algebra algebra, string name)
    match algebra.polynomials.get(name)
        Polynomial value
            return value
        none
            return error("UNKNOWN " + name)

void save(Algebra &algebra, string name, const Polynomial value)
    .algebra.polynomials.set(name, value)
    emit(name + " = " + notation(value))

Polynomial | error checked_product(const Polynomial left, const Polynomial right)
    if degree(left) >= 0 and degree(right) >= 0 and degree(left) + degree(right) > 30
        return error("DEGREE LIMIT")
    return product(left, right)

Polynomial | error checked_power(const Polynomial polynomial, int exponent)
    if degree(polynomial) >= 0 and degree(polynomial) * exponent > 30
        return error("DEGREE LIMIT")
    return power(polynomial, exponent)

Polynomial | error checked_composition(const Polynomial outer, const Polynomial inner)
    if degree(outer) >= 1 and degree(inner) >= 1 and degree(outer) * degree(inner) > 30
        return error("DEGREE LIMIT")
    return compose(outer, inner)

enum Operation
    Literal
    Variable
    Reference
    Negative
    Add
    Subtract
    Multiply
    Divide
    Power
    Compose

class Token(string word, int position)

class Node(Operation kind, number := 0, name := "", left := -1, right := -1)

class Parser(Token[] tokens, position := 0, Node[] nodes := [])

bool digit(string character)
    return #character == 1 and "0123456789".contains(character)

bool upper(string character)
    return #character == 1 and "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ".contains(character)

Parser tokenize(string expression)
    Token[] tokens := []
    position := 0
    while position < int(#expression)
        character := expression[position]
        if character == " "
            position += 1
            continue
        start := position
        position += 1
        if digit(character)
            while position < int(#expression) and digit(expression[position])
                position += 1
        elif upper(character)
            while position < int(#expression) and (upper(expression[position]) or digit(expression[position]))
                position += 1
        tokens = tokens.append(Token(expression[start:<position], start + 1))
    return Parser(tokens)

string peek(const Parser parser)
    return if parser.position == int(#parser.tokens) then "" else parser.tokens[parser.position].word

string syntax_message(const Parser parser)
    return if parser.position == int(#parser.tokens) then "SYNTAX AT END" else "SYNTAX AT {parser.tokens[parser.position].position}"

int append_node(Parser &parser, const Node item)
    index := int(#parser.nodes)
    parser.nodes = parser.nodes.append(item)
    return index

int | error parse_expression(Parser &parser);

int | error parse_primary(Parser &parser)
    word := peek(parser)
    if word == ""
        return error(syntax_message(parser))
    if digit(word[0])
        parser.position += 1
        return append_node(&parser, Node(Operation.Literal, number = parse_integer(word)))
    if word == "x"
        parser.position += 1
        return append_node(&parser, Node(Operation.Variable))
    if upper(word[0])
        parser.position += 1
        count := 0
        while peek(parser) == "'"
            count += 1
            parser.position += 1
        reference := append_node(&parser, Node(Operation.Reference, number = count, name = word))
        if peek(parser) == "("
            parser.position += 1
            argument := try parse_expression(&parser)
            if peek(parser) != ")"
                return error(syntax_message(parser))
            parser.position += 1
            return append_node(&parser, Node(Operation.Compose, left = reference, right = argument))
        return reference
    if word == "("
        parser.position += 1
        inside := try parse_expression(&parser)
        if peek(parser) != ")"
            return error(syntax_message(parser))
        parser.position += 1
        return inside
    return error(syntax_message(parser))

int | error parse_factor(Parser &parser)
    result := try parse_primary(&parser)
    if peek(parser) == "^"
        parser.position += 1
        word := peek(parser)
        if word == "" or not digit(word[0])
            return error(syntax_message(parser))
        parser.position += 1
        result = append_node(&parser, Node(Operation.Power, number = parse_integer(word), left = result))
    return result

int | error parse_term(Parser &parser)
    result := try parse_factor(&parser)
    while true
        word := peek(parser)
        Operation operation := Operation.Multiply
        if word == "*" or word == "/"
            if word == "/"
                operation = Operation.Divide
            parser.position += 1
        elif word != "" and (word == "x" or word == "(" or upper(word[0]))
            operation = Operation.Multiply
        else
            return result
        following := try parse_factor(&parser)
        result = append_node(&parser, Node(operation, left = result, right = following))

int | error parse_expression(Parser &parser)
    negative := peek(parser) == "-"
    if negative
        parser.position += 1
    result := try parse_term(&parser)
    if negative
        result = append_node(&parser, Node(Operation.Negative, left = result))
    while peek(parser) == "+" or peek(parser) == "-"
        Operation operation := if peek(parser) == "+" then Operation.Add else Operation.Subtract
        parser.position += 1
        following := try parse_term(&parser)
        result = append_node(&parser, Node(operation, left = result, right = following))
    return result

Polynomial | error evaluate_node(const Algebra algebra, const Node[] nodes, int index)
    item := nodes[index]
    if item.kind == Operation.Literal
        return constant(real(item.number))
    if item.kind == Operation.Variable
        return Polynomial([0.0, 1.0])
    if item.kind == Operation.Reference
        referenced := try lookup(algebra, item.name)
        return differentiated(referenced, item.number)
    left := try evaluate_node(algebra, nodes, item.left)
    if item.kind == Operation.Negative
        return negated(left)
    if item.kind == Operation.Power
        return checked_power(left, item.number)
    right := try evaluate_node(algebra, nodes, item.right)
    if item.kind == Operation.Add
        return add(left, right)
    if item.kind == Operation.Subtract
        return subtract(left, right)
    if item.kind == Operation.Multiply
        return checked_product(left, right)
    if item.kind == Operation.Compose
        return checked_composition(left, right)
    if degree(right) < 0
        return error("DIVISION BY ZERO")
    if degree(right) > 0
        return error("NONCONSTANT DIVISOR")
    return divided(left, right.coefficients[0])

class Root(real value, int multiplicity)

class RationalRoots(Root[] roots, Polynomial remaining)

int[] divisors(int value)
    return [for candidate := (1:<(int(value) + 1))[] if value % candidate == 0 then candidate]

RationalRoots rational_roots(const Polynomial polynomial)
    remaining := primitive(polynomial)
    zeros := 0
    while remaining.coefficients[0] == 0.0
        remaining = Polynomial(remaining.coefficients[1:])
        zeros += 1
    common_denominator := int(leading(remaining))
    int[] candidate_keys := []
    for numerator := divisors(math.abs(int(remaining.coefficients[0])))[]
        for denominator := divisors(common_denominator)[]
            if gcd_integer(numerator, denominator) == 1
                key := numerator * (common_denominator / denominator)
                candidate_keys = candidate_keys.append(key).append(-key)
    Root[] roots := []
    for key := candidate_keys.sorted()[]
        candidate := real(key) / real(common_denominator)
        parts := ratio_parts(candidate)
        factor := Polynomial([real(-parts.numerator), real(parts.denominator)])
        multiplicity := 0
        while degree(remaining) >= 1 and evaluate(remaining, candidate) == 0.0
            remaining = divide_polynomials(remaining, factor).quotient
            multiplicity += 1
        if multiplicity > 0
            roots = roots.append(Root(candidate, multiplicity))
    if zeros > 0
        insertion := 0
        while insertion < int(#roots) and roots[insertion].value < 0.0
            insertion += 1
        roots = roots[0:<insertion].append(Root(0.0, zeros)).concat(roots[insertion:])
    return RationalRoots(roots, remaining)

string factor_text(const Polynomial polynomial, int multiplicity, simple_x := false)
    text := if simple_x then "x" else "(" + notation(polynomial) + ")"
    if multiplicity >= 2
        text += "^{multiplicity}"
    return " * " + text

string factorization(const Polynomial polynomial)
    factors := rational_roots(polynomial)
    result := fraction_text(content(polynomial))
    for root := factors.roots[]
        parts := ratio_parts(root.value)
        factor := Polynomial([real(-parts.numerator), real(parts.denominator)])
        result += factor_text(factor, root.multiplicity, root.value == 0.0)
    if degree(factors.remaining) >= 1
        result += factor_text(factors.remaining, 1)
    return result

string squarefree_factors(const Polynomial polynomial)
    result := fraction_text(content(polynomial))
    if degree(polynomial) == 0
        return result
    w0 := monic(polynomial)
    common := gcd_polynomials(w0, derivative(w0))
    remaining := divide_polynomials(w0, common).quotient
    multiplicity := 1
    while degree(remaining) >= 1
        next := gcd_polynomials(remaining, common)
        factor := divide_polynomials(remaining, next).quotient
        if degree(factor) >= 1
            whole := primitive(factor)
            result += factor_text(whole, multiplicity, whole == Polynomial([0.0, 1.0]))
        common = divide_polynomials(common, next).quotient
        remaining = next
        multiplicity += 1
    return result

int sign_of(real value)
    return if value < 0.0 then -1 elif value > 0.0 then 1 else 0

int sign_changes(const int[] signs)
    previous := 0
    result := 0
    for current := signs[]
        if current != 0
            if previous != 0 and current != previous
                result += 1
            previous = current
    return result

class Bound(infinity := 0, value := 0.0)

Bound | error bound_literal(string text)
    if text == "-inf"
        return Bound(-1)
    if text == "inf"
        return Bound(1)
    return Bound(value = try rational(text))

bool before(const Bound left, const Bound right)
    if left.infinity == 0 and right.infinity == 0
        return left.value < right.value
    return left.infinity < right.infinity

string bound_text(const Bound bound)
    return if bound.infinity < 0 then "-inf" elif bound.infinity > 0 then "inf" else fraction_text(bound.value)

Polynomial[] sturm_sequence(const Polynomial polynomial)
    previous := squarefree_part(polynomial)
    current := derivative(previous)
    sequence := [previous]
    while degree(current) >= 0
        sequence = sequence.append(current)
        following := negated(divide_polynomials(previous, current).remainder)
        previous = current
        current = following
    return sequence

int variations(const Polynomial[] sequence, const Bound point)
    int[] signs := []
    for polynomial := sequence[]
        sign := if point.infinity == 0 then sign_of(evaluate(polynomial, point.value)) else sign_of(leading(polynomial))
        if point.infinity < 0 and degree(polynomial) % 2 != 0
            sign = -sign
        signs = signs.append(sign)
    return sign_changes(signs)

int root_count(const Polynomial[] sequence, const Bound low, const Bound high)
    return variations(sequence, low) - variations(sequence, high)

class Interval(real low, real high)

Interval[] examine(const Polynomial[] sequence, real low, real high, real width)
    count := root_count(sequence, Bound(value = low), Bound(value = high))
    if count >= 2
        middle := (low + high) / 2.0
        left := examine(sequence, low, middle, width)
        right := examine(sequence, middle, high, width)
        return left.concat(right)
    if count == 1
        while high - low > width
            middle := (low + high) / 2.0
            if root_count(sequence, Bound(value = low), Bound(value = middle)) >= 1
                high = middle
            else
                low = middle
        return [Interval(low, high)]
    return []

Interval[] isolate(const Polynomial polynomial, int precision)
    sequence := sturm_sequence(polynomial)
    first := sequence[0]
    beta := 1.0
    if degree(first) > 0
        beta += math.abs(first.coefficients[0:<degree(first)] / leading(first)).max()
    return examine(sequence, -beta, beta, 1.0 / real(2 ^ precision))

real resultant(Polynomial first, Polynomial second)
    result := 1.0
    while degree(second) >= 1
        remainder := divide_polynomials(first, second).remainder
        if degree(remainder) < 0
            return 0.0
        result *= scalar_power(leading(second), degree(first) - degree(remainder))
        if degree(first) * degree(second) % 2 != 0
            result = -result
        first = second
        second = remainder
    return result * scalar_power(second.coefficients[0], degree(first))

Polynomial | error interpolate(const real[] values)
    xs := [for index := (0:<int(#values):2)[] then values[index]]
    differences := [for index := (1:<int(#values))[] if index % 2 == 1 then values[index]]
    count := int(#xs)
    for: 1 <= index < count
        if includes(xs[0:<index], xs[index])
            return error("DUPLICATE X " + fraction_text(xs[index]))
    for: 1 <= order < count
        for: count - 1 >= index >= order step -1
            differences[index] = (differences[index] - differences[index - 1]) / (xs[index] - xs[index - order])
    result := Polynomial()
    for: count - 1 >= index >= 0 step -1
        result = add(product(result, Polynomial([-xs[index], 1.0])), constant(differences[index]))
    return result

Polynomial | error special(string kind, int order)
    if not includes(["chebyshev", "chebyshev2", "legendre", "hermite", "laguerre"], kind)
        return error("UNKNOWN KIND " + kind)
    if order > 30
        return error("DEGREE LIMIT")
    previous := constant(1.0)
    if order == 0
        return previous
    current := Polynomial([0.0, 1.0])
    if kind == "chebyshev2" or kind == "hermite"
        current = Polynomial([0.0, 2.0])
    elif kind == "laguerre"
        current = Polynomial([1.0, -1.0])
    for: 1 <= index < order
        factor := Polynomial([0.0, 2.0])
        multiplier := 1.0
        if kind == "legendre"
            factor = Polynomial([0.0, real(2 * index + 1)])
            multiplier = real(index)
        elif kind == "hermite"
            multiplier = real(2 * index)
        elif kind == "laguerre"
            factor = Polynomial([real(2 * index + 1), -1.0])
            multiplier = real(index)
        following := subtract(product(factor, current), scaled(previous, multiplier))
        if kind == "legendre" or kind == "laguerre"
            following = scaled(following, 1.0 / real(index + 1))
        previous = current
        current = following
    return current

int[] operand_indices(string command)
    if includes(["PRINT", "DELETE", "DEGREE", "AREA", "TAYLOR", "EVAL", "ROOTS", "FACTOR", "SQFREE", "DESCARTES", "STURM", "ISOLATE", "DISCRIM", "POWERSUM"], command)
        return [1]
    if includes(["ADD", "SUB", "MUL", "GCD", "LCM", "INVMOD", "COMPOSE"], command)
        return [2, 3]
    if includes(["POW", "DERIV", "INTEG", "TANGENT"], command)
        return [2]
    if command == "DIV"
        return [3, 4]
    if command == "XGCD"
        return [4, 5]
    if command == "CRT"
        return [2, 3, 4, 5]
    if command == "MODPOW"
        return [2, 4]
    if command == "RESULTANT"
        return [1, 2]
    return []

void | error execute(Algebra &algebra, string line)
    args := line.split(" ")
    command := args[0]
    if command == "DEF"
        destination := args[1]
        parser := tokenize(line[5 + int(#destination):])
        root := try parse_expression(&parser)
        if parser.position != int(#parser.tokens)
            return error(syntax_message(parser))
        defined := try evaluate_node(algebra, parser.nodes, root)
        save(&algebra, destination, defined)
        return void
    if command == "DIV" and args[1] == args[2]
        return error("SAME NAME")
    if command == "XGCD" and (args[1] == args[2] or args[1] == args[3] or args[2] == args[3])
        return error("SAME NAME")
    Polynomial[] operands := []
    for index := operand_indices(command)[]
        operands = operands.append(try lookup(algebra, args[index]))
    real[] values := []
    literal_start := -1
    if includes(["AREA", "TAYLOR", "EVAL", "INTERP"], command)
        literal_start = 2
    elif command == "TANGENT"
        literal_start = 3
    if literal_start >= 0
        for: literal_start <= index < int(#args)
            values = values.append(try rational(args[index]))
    low := Bound()
    high := Bound()
    if command == "STURM"
        low = try bound_literal(args[2])
        high = try bound_literal(args[3])
    first := if #operands > 0 then operands[0] else Polynomial()
    second := if #operands > 1 then operands[1] else Polynomial()
    name := if #args > 1 then args[1] else ""
    if command == "PRINT"
        emit(name + " = " + notation(first))
    elif command == "DELETE"
        .algebra.polynomials.remove(name)
        emit("deleted " + name)
    elif command == "LIST"
        names := algebra.polynomials.keys().sorted()
        if #names == 0
            emit("no polynomials")
        for key := names[]
            stored := try lookup(algebra, key)
            emit(key + " = " + notation(stored))
    elif command == "DEGREE"
        amount := if degree(first) < 0 then "-inf" else string(degree(first))
        emit("deg({name}) = {amount}")
    elif command == "ADD"
        save(&algebra, name, add(first, second))
    elif command == "SUB"
        save(&algebra, name, subtract(first, second))
    elif command == "MUL"
        save(&algebra, name, try checked_product(first, second))
    elif command == "POW"
        save(&algebra, name, try checked_power(first, parse_integer(args[3])))
    elif command == "DIV"
        if degree(second) < 0
            return error("DIVISION BY ZERO")
        division := divide_polynomials(first, second)
        save(&algebra, name, division.quotient)
        save(&algebra, args[2], division.remainder)
    elif command == "GCD"
        save(&algebra, name, gcd_polynomials(first, second))
    elif command == "XGCD"
        result := extended_gcd(first, second)
        save(&algebra, name, result.common)
        save(&algebra, args[2], result.left)
        save(&algebra, args[3], result.right)
    elif command == "LCM"
        result := Polynomial()
        if degree(first) >= 0 and degree(second) >= 0
            common := gcd_polynomials(first, second)
            if degree(first) + degree(second) - degree(common) > 30
                return error("DEGREE LIMIT")
            result = monic(product(divide_polynomials(first, common).quotient, second))
        save(&algebra, name, result)
    elif command == "INVMOD"
        if degree(second) < 0
            return error("DIVISION BY ZERO")
        if degree(second) == 0
            return error("DEGREE TOO LOW")
        result := extended_gcd(first, second)
        if result.common != constant(1.0)
            return error("NOT COPRIME")
        save(&algebra, name, divide_polynomials(result.left, second).remainder)
    elif command == "CRT"
        m1 := operands[1]
        a2 := operands[2]
        m2 := operands[3]
        if degree(m1) < 0 or degree(m2) < 0
            return error("DIVISION BY ZERO")
        if degree(m1) + degree(m2) > 30
            return error("DEGREE LIMIT")
        result := extended_gcd(m1, m2)
        if result.common != constant(1.0)
            return error("NOT COPRIME")
        r1 := divide_polynomials(first, m1).remainder
        r2 := divide_polynomials(a2, m2).remainder
        correction := divide_polynomials(product(subtract(r2, r1), result.left), m2).remainder
        save(&algebra, name, add(r1, product(m1, correction)))
    elif command == "MODPOW"
        if degree(second) < 0
            return error("DIVISION BY ZERO")
        if 2 * degree(second) - 2 > 30
            return error("DEGREE LIMIT")
        result := divide_polynomials(constant(1.0), second).remainder
        base := divide_polynomials(first, second).remainder
        exponent := parse_integer(args[3])
        while exponent > 0
            if exponent % 2 != 0
                result = divide_polynomials(product(result, base), second).remainder
            exponent /= 2
            if exponent > 0
                base = divide_polynomials(product(base, base), second).remainder
        save(&algebra, name, result)
    elif command == "DERIV"
        save(&algebra, name, differentiated(first, parse_integer(args[3])))
    elif command == "INTEG"
        if degree(first) + 1 > 30
            return error("DEGREE LIMIT")
        save(&algebra, name, integral(first))
    elif command == "AREA"
        antiderivative := integral(first)
        value := evaluate(antiderivative, values[1]) - evaluate(antiderivative, values[0])
        emit("integral({name}, {fraction_text(values[0])}, {fraction_text(values[1])}) = {fraction_text(value)}")
    elif command == "TANGENT"
        height := evaluate(first, values[0])
        slope := evaluate(derivative(first), values[0])
        save(&algebra, name, normalized([height - slope * values[0], slope]))
    elif command == "TAYLOR"
        center := values[0]
        variable := "x"
        if center > 0.0
            variable = "(x - {fraction_text(center)})"
        elif center < 0.0
            variable = "(x + {fraction_text(-center)})"
        emit("taylor({name}, {fraction_text(center)}) = {notation(compose(first, Polynomial([center, 1.0])), variable)}")
    elif command == "COMPOSE"
        save(&algebra, name, try checked_composition(first, second))
    elif command == "EVAL"
        for point := values[]
            emit("{name}({fraction_text(point)}) = {fraction_text(evaluate(first, point))}")
    elif command == "INTERP"
        save(&algebra, name, try interpolate(values))
    elif command == "SPECIAL"
        save(&algebra, name, try special(args[2], parse_integer(args[3])))
    else
        if degree(first) < 0
            return error("ZERO POLYNOMIAL")
        if command == "ROOTS"
            roots := rational_roots(first)
            terms := [for entry := roots.roots[] then "{fraction_text(entry.value)} ({entry.multiplicity})"]
            text := if #terms == 0 then "none" else terms.join(", ")
            emit("roots({name}) = {text}")
        elif command == "FACTOR"
            emit("factor({name}) = {factorization(first)}")
        elif command == "SQFREE"
            emit("sqfree({name}) = {squarefree_factors(first)}")
        elif command == "DESCARTES"
            positive := sign_changes([for index := (int(degree(first)):>-1)[] then sign_of(first.coefficients[index])])
            negative := sign_changes([for index := (int(degree(first)):>-1)[] then sign_of(first.coefficients[index]) * (if index % 2 == 0 then 1 else -1)])
            emit("descartes({name}) = positive {positive}, negative {negative}")
        elif command == "STURM"
            if not before(low, high)
                return error("BAD INTERVAL")
            count := root_count(sturm_sequence(first), low, high)
            emit("sturm({name}, {bound_text(low)}, {bound_text(high)}) = {count}")
        elif command == "ISOLATE"
            precision := parse_integer(args[2])
            intervals := isolate(first, precision)
            terms := [for interval := intervals[] then "({fraction_text(interval.low)}, {fraction_text(interval.high)}]"]
            text := if #terms == 0 then "none" else terms.join(", ")
            emit("isolate({name}, {precision}) = {text}")
        elif command == "RESULTANT"
            if degree(second) < 0
                return error("ZERO POLYNOMIAL")
            emit("res({name}, {args[2]}) = {fraction_text(resultant(first, second))}")
        elif command == "DISCRIM" or command == "POWERSUM"
            order := degree(first)
            if order == 0
                return error("DEGREE TOO LOW")
            if command == "DISCRIM"
                value := resultant(first, derivative(first)) / leading(first)
                if order * (order - 1) / 2 % 2 != 0
                    value = -value
                emit("disc({name}) = {fraction_text(value)}")
            else
                unit := monic(first)
                sums := [0.0]
                for: 1 <= exponent <= parse_integer(args[2])
                    total := if exponent <= order then real(exponent) * unit.coefficients[order - exponent] else 0.0
                    for: 1 <= index <= math.min(exponent - 1, order)
                        total += unit.coefficients[order - index] * sums[exponent - index]
                    sums = sums.append(-total)
                terms := [for value := sums[1:][] then fraction_text(value)]
                emit("powersum({name}) = " + terms.join(", "))
    return void

calculator := Algebra()
int command_count
scan(&command_count)
for: 0 <= command_index < command_count
    string command_line
    scan(&command_line)
    match execute(&calculator, command_line)
        void
            continue
        error problem
            emit("ERROR " + problem.message)
